    try {
      var parts = document.cookie.split("SLOT_PAYLOADS=");

      if (raw) {
        var decoded;

  overflow: hidden;

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper {
  position: fixed;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 99999;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner {
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner--off-screen-left {
  animation-name: slideLeft;
  animation-duration: 0.5s;
  animation-timing-function: ease;
  margin-left: 0%;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner--off-screen-up {
  animation-name: slideUp;
  animation-duration: 0.75s;
  animation-timing-function: ease;
  bottom: 10%;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner--off-screen-down {
  animation-name: slideDown;
  animation-duration: 0.75s;
  animation-timing-function: ease;
  bottom: -20%;
}

@keyframes slideLeft {
  0% {
    margin-left: 100%;
  }
  100% {
    margin-left: 0%;
  }
}

@keyframes slideUp {
  0% {
    bottom: -20%;
  }
  100% {
    bottom: 10%;
  }
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__bs-image {
  margin-right: 5px;
  margin-top: 3px;
  height: 15px;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__close {
  color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 30px;
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: 0;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  z-index: 1;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__close--down {
  top: 40px;
}

}

}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__input-label {
  align-self: center;
  color: #3E7697;
  display: block;
  margin-top: 15px;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__input-wrapper {
  bottom: 30px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-left: 20px;
  margin-right: 20px;
  position: absolute;
  background-color: white;
  z-index: 1;
  padding: 15px;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__error {
  background-color: white;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 200px;
  justify-content: space-evenly;
  left: 0;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-left: auto;
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  width: 80%;
  z-index: 2;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__error--bold {
  font-size: 18px;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__error--centered {
  text-align: center;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__error--padded {
  padding: 0 40px;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__tip {
  background-color: white;
  display: flex;
  left: 0;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-left: auto;
  padding: 15px;
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  width: 80%;
  z-index: 1;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__tip--hidden {
  bottom: -20%;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__tip-image {
  height: 15px;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__image-capture {
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__video {
  height: 100%;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__view-port {
  align-items: center;
  background-color: black;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__view-port:after {

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__view-port--success:after {

  var parentComponentPrefixes = ['price:', 'visual-navigation:'];
  var observerKey = 'priceWasObserver';

  var parentSelector = parentComponentPrefixes
    .map(function (prefix) {

  var strikeSelector = 's,del,strike,[class~="sui-line-through"],[class*="line-through"]';

  function processNode(node) {
    if (!node) return;

    // Text nodes have no subtree to walk; scan from the element that owns them.
    var root = node.nodeType === 3 ? node.parentElement : node;
    if (!root || root.nodeType !== 1) return;

    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
    var matches = [];
    var textNode;

    while ((textNode = walker.nextNode())) {
      if (/\bwas\b/i.test(textNode.nodeValue)) matches.push(textNode);
    }

    matches.forEach(function (match) {
      var parent = match.parentElement;
      if (!parent || !parent.isConnected) return;

      // Strip the label only: keep the struck-through amount it precedes.
      var priceEl = parent.closest('p') || parent;

      // "Was" paired with a struck-through amount, or a stray label inside a
      // known price component.
      if (priceEl.querySelector(strikeSelector) || parent.closest(parentSelector)) {
        match.nodeValue = match.nodeValue.replace(/\bwas\b[\s\u00A0]*/gi, '');
      }
    });
  }

  function scanPage() {
    processNode(document.documentElement);
  }

  function startWasRemoval() {
    if (!document.body) {
      requestAnimationFrame(startWasRemoval);
      return;
    }

    if (window[observerKey]) {
      window[observerKey].disconnect();
    }

    window[observerKey] = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
      mutations.forEach(function (mutation) {
        if (mutation.type === 'childList') {
          mutation.addedNodes.forEach(processNode);
        }

        if (mutation.type === 'characterData') {
          processNode(mutation.target);
        }
      });
    });

    window[observerKey].observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
      characterData: true
    });

  }

  (function () {
    var domain = window.location.hostname.indexOf('homedepot.com') !== -1 ? '.homedepot.com' : '.homedepotdev.com';
    try {
      var parts = document.cookie.split("SLOT_PAYLOADS=");
      var raw = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1].split(";")[0] : null;

      if (raw) {
        var decoded;
        try {
          decoded = decodeURIComponent(raw);
        } catch (e) {
          decoded = raw;
        }

        var payloads;
        try {
          payloads = JSON.parse(decoded);
        } catch (e) {
          payloads = null;
        }

        if (Array.isArray(payloads) && payloads.length > 0) {
          window.globalMetadata = window.globalMetadata || {};
          window.globalMetadata.experimentation = window.globalMetadata.experimentation || {};
          window.globalMetadata.experimentation.server = window.globalMetadata.experimentation.server || {};

            window.globalMetadata.experimentation.server.adobe.concat(payloads);

          document.cookie = "SLOT_PAYLOADS=; Max-Age=0; path=/; domain=" + domain;
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error executing slot payloads script", err);
      document.cookie = "SLOT_PAYLOADS=; Max-Age=0; path=/; domain=" + domain;
    }
  })();

    <div class="hfapp" style="display:contents" data-reactroot=""><style id="header-static-styles">.hfapp .bs-no-scroll {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper {
  position: fixed;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 99999;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner {
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner--off-screen-left {
  animation-name: slideLeft;
  animation-duration: 0.5s;
  animation-timing-function: ease;
  margin-left: 0%;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner--off-screen-up {
  animation-name: slideUp;
  animation-duration: 0.75s;
  animation-timing-function: ease;
  bottom: 10%;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner--off-screen-down {
  animation-name: slideDown;
  animation-duration: 0.75s;
  animation-timing-function: ease;
  bottom: -20%;
}

@keyframes slideLeft {
  0% {
    margin-left: 100%;
  }
  100% {
    margin-left: 0%;
  }
}

@keyframes slideUp {
  0% {
    bottom: -20%;
  }
  100% {
    bottom: 10%;
  }
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__bs-image {
  margin-right: 5px;
  margin-top: 3px;
  height: 15px;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__close {
  color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 30px;
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: 0;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  z-index: 1;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__close--down {
  top: 40px;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__icon--error {
  margin-left: -32px;
  margin-top: -3px;
  padding-right: 5px;
}

.hfapp #js-barcode-scanner__wrapper .barcode-scanner__input {
  display: none;

 (function () {
  var parentComponentPrefixes = ['price:', 'visual-navigation:'];
  var observerKey = 'priceWasObserver';

  var parentSelector = parentComponentPrefixes
    .map(function (prefix) {
      return '[data-component^="' + prefix + '"]';
    })
    .join(',');

  // Elements that render the struck-through "was" amount.
  var strikeSelector = 's,del,strike,[class~="sui-line-through"],[class*="line-through"]';

  function processNode(node) {
    if (!node) return;

    // Text nodes have no subtree to walk; scan from the element that owns them.
    var root = node.nodeType === 3 ? node.parentElement : node;
    if (!root || root.nodeType !== 1) return;

    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
    var matches = [];
    var textNode;

    while ((textNode = walker.nextNode())) {
      if (/\bwas\b/i.test(textNode.nodeValue)) matches.push(textNode);
    }

    matches.forEach(function (match) {
      var parent = match.parentElement;
      if (!parent || !parent.isConnected) return;

      // Strip the label only: keep the struck-through amount it precedes.
      var priceEl = parent.closest('p') || parent;

      // "Was" paired with a struck-through amount, or a stray label inside a
      // known price component.
      if (priceEl.querySelector(strikeSelector) || parent.closest(parentSelector)) {
        match.nodeValue = match.nodeValue.replace(/\bwas\b[\s\u00A0]*/gi, '');
      }
    });
  }

  function scanPage() {
    processNode(document.documentElement);
  }

  function startWasRemoval() {
    if (!document.body) {
      requestAnimationFrame(startWasRemoval);
      return;
    }

    if (window[observerKey]) {
      window[observerKey].disconnect();
    }

    window[observerKey] = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
      mutations.forEach(function (mutation) {
        if (mutation.type === 'childList') {
          mutation.addedNodes.forEach(processNode);
        }

        if (mutation.type === 'characterData') {
          processNode(mutation.target);
        }
      });
    });

    window[observerKey].observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
      characterData: true
    });

    scanPage();

    window.addEventListener('load', scanPage, { once: true });
  }

  startWasRemoval();
})();

  (function () {
    var domain = window.location.hostname.indexOf('homedepot.com') !== -1 ? '.homedepot.com' : '.homedepotdev.com';
    try {
      var parts = document.cookie.split("SLOT_PAYLOADS=");
      var raw = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1].split(";")[0] : null;

      if (raw) {
        var decoded;
        try {
          decoded = decodeURIComponent(raw);
        } catch (e) {
          decoded = raw;
        }

        var payloads;
        try {
          payloads = JSON.parse(decoded);
        } catch (e) {
          payloads = null;
        }

        if (Array.isArray(payloads) && payloads.length > 0) {
          window.globalMetadata = window.globalMetadata || {};
          window.globalMetadata.experimentation = window.globalMetadata.experimentation || {};
          window.globalMetadata.experimentation.server = window.globalMetadata.experimentation.server || {};

            window.globalMetadata.experimentation.server.adobe.concat(payloads);

          document.cookie = "SLOT_PAYLOADS=; Max-Age=0; path=/; domain=" + domain;
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error executing slot payloads script", err);
      document.cookie = "SLOT_PAYLOADS=; Max-Age=0; path=/; domain=" + domain;
    }
  })();

  var strikeSelector = 's,del,strike,[class~="sui-line-through"],[class*="line-through"]';

  function processNode(node) {
    if (!node) return;

    // Text nodes have no subtree to walk; scan from the element that owns them.
    var root = node.nodeType === 3 ? node.parentElement : node;
    if (!root || root.nodeType !== 1) return;

    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
    var matches = [];

      if (/\bwas\b/i.test(textNode.nodeValue)) matches.push(textNode);
    }

    matches.forEach(function (match) {
      var parent = match.parentElement;
      if (!parent || !parent.isConnected) return;

      // Strip the label only: keep the struck-through amount it precedes.
      var priceEl = parent.closest('p') || parent;

      // "Was" paired with a struck-through amount, or a stray label inside a
      // known price component.
      if (priceEl.querySelector(strikeSelector) || parent.closest(parentSelector)) {

    processNode(document.documentElement);

    }

      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
